title: aigdbench TaskPackage input (spec/v1)
description: Input contract read from /in/input.json by .beaver/tasks/aigdbench/run.sh. Matches the {driver, testcase} shape already documented for the beaver-godot binding.

driver.description: noop runs the unmodified baseline (contract: mean_score 0.00); patch applies the testcase's own fix.diff golden fix (contract: mean_score 1.00 for a healthy testcase).

testcase.description: Bare id of a testcases/<id>/ directory in this repo (no path separators, no leading dot). Defaults to collision-layer-precise-edit, a self-contained, verified-healthy (noop=0.00, patch=1.00) folder-type case, when omitted.
